description: Search for a book across every bookseller Near Fine covers for the buyer's country (AbeBooks and eBay sites everywhere, plus World of Books, ThriftBooks, Better World Books, Books-A-Million, TextbookX, Casa del Libro, Hugendubel, Lehmanns, buch7, preigu, Booklooker, Leslibraires.fr, Eyrolles, Rarewaves, Ex Libris, Libreria Casagrande, Librairie Mollat, Boekwinkeltjes.nl, Standaard Boekhandel, Managementboek, Bookmatch.nl, Evenaar, Dubray Books, Malliaris-Paideia, Book Odyssey, Indigo, Archambault, Librairie Paragraphe, Munro's Books, Pulp Fiction Books, Bolen Books, Book City, Elliott Bay Book Company, Books Are Magic, Porchlight Book Company, Kinokuniya, Daunt Books, Paper Cavalier, Lets Buy Books, Bookshop.org, LoveReading, BookKind, Goldsboro Books, The Broken Binding, Golden Hare Books, Archway Bookshop, Shelter, Shapero Rare Books, Henry Sotheran's, The Bookshop in Wigtown, Chapters Bookstore, Harry Hartog, Book Grocer, Whitcoulls, Bokkilden, Bog & idé, Suomalainen Kirjakauppa, Booky.fi, Campusbokhandeln, Sellpy, Raamatukoi, Zvaigzne ABC, Bookbot, Świat Książki, Matras, Luxor, Kosmas, Trh knih, Bookline, Antikvarium.hu, Ciela, EMKA, Tzomet Sfarim, IBS, Libraccio, Giunti al Punto, Agapea, Popular Libros, Laie, Label Emmaüs, Gandhi, Porrúa, Gonvill, Livraria da Travessa, Martins Fontes, Companhia das Letras, Librería de la U, Ibero Librerías, Contrapunto, Eterna Cadencia, Escaramuza, Maruzen Junkudo, BookOff, NetOff, Kyobo, Yes24, TAAZE, San Min, Book Outlet, Livrenpoche, Buybook, Exclusive Books, Readers Warehouse, Wordsworth Books, Graffiti Books, Loot.co.za, Popular, MPH, BookXcess, National Book Store, Fully Booked, Bookazine, Atlantic Books, Kitabay, Liberty Books, Tecni-Ciencia, Librairie Club, Books Upstairs, Nexus, Czytam.pl, Americanas, Livrarias Curitiba, Kel Ediciones and SBS Librerías where they ship, and Apple Books ebooks and audiobooks; shops' ebooks and audiobook downloads only in their own country). Pass an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 for an exact edition, or title and author keywords. The query can also carry a price cap, as in "under $40" or "max 30 €" (in the buyer's currency when it names none), and ask for a first edition, a signed copy, a dust jacket, a hardcover or a paperback, as in "wolf hall signed first edition under £200", or for an ebook or audiobook alone. Offers over the cap, counting known shipping, and offers in other formats than the one asked for are left out; criteria reports what was read. Returns offers sorted cheapest first, each with title, seller, condition (new, used, ebook or audiobook), price and shipping in the seller's currency, the same in the buyer's currency when it differs, and the URL to buy. Shipping is left out where the shop doesn't publish it. Each offer may carry a match from 0 to 1: how sure a decision model is that the listing is the book searched for rather than a study guide, summary, adaptation or another book that shares a word. Below about 0.2 it rarely is. When the query asks for attributes, each offer carries verdicts: true where the decision model, reading the listing and any filter the bookseller applied, confirms the listing claims it, false where it doesn't, and left out where unjudged. Also reports which sources answered, failed or timed out, an amazon_url that opens the same search on the buyer's Amazon site, and a search_url that opens it on Near Fine, where the buyer can set an alert and get an email when a new listing turns up with everything the query asks for. A search takes a few seconds.

country.description: Country the buyer is in, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as US, GB or DE. Defaults to US.

query.description: ISBN-10, ISBN-13 (hyphens and spaces allowed) or title and author keywords, optionally with a price cap and attributes such as "first edition under $40"
